verdict.rationale: Fellow documents both parts of the story. Organizations can set configurable retention policies, including zero-day retention. The Super Admin API can retrieve, export, and delete workspace data, including deleting notes through the API. However, retention configuration appears only in marketing copy, and deletion is limited to Enterprise-plan super admins. missing for 10: detailed retention-policy configuration docs (durations, scopes, per-data-type controls), user-level deletion controls for non-admin users, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Set configurable retention policies, including zero-day retention, so data is handled according to your organization’s requirements.
Set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained

Fellow’s Super Admin API lets designated Enterprise‑plan administrators retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace, making it simple to back up notes and transcripts for legal purposes and to erase third‑party data in line with privacy regulations.
Only users with super admin privileges can delete notes through the API.
